scope: Pure reference-occurrence counting for Circuit with at-most-two fanins.
Every computed index except the last must occur somewhere among gate inputs; this is an explicit counting premise, not a proved semantic liveness normalization.
The unique-raw-input result additionally assumes each raw input occurs and size+1<2*n. The n14,size<=26 specialization follows.
Padding lemma is a list-count identity and explicitly assumes output>=n; it does not assert semantic padding correctness or derive the premise.
No arbitrary-circuit27gate bound, exact26witness, or posted-gap theorem is claimed.
format: Only Defs import; exact auxiliary namespace; lemma declarations only; no forbidden source forms detected.
